AudioLeveler_target.tip: How loud every song is made, so they all match. FPP's volume sets how loud the show plays. -14 suits most shows, FM included.

AudioLeveler_ceiling.tip: The loudest a peak may get, so nothing distorts. -1.5 leaves room for FM transmitters, which boost treble.

AudioLeveler_match.tip: Radios and small speakers barely play deep bass, so bass-heavy songs sound quieter. This nudges each song by up to 4 dB to make up for it, as FPP's Normalize does.

AudioLeveler_bgOffset.tip: How far under the show songs set to Background play, like ambiance or off-hours music.

AudioLeveler_allowLimiter.description: Use the limiter for songs Normalize leaves short
AudioLeveler_allowLimiter.tip: Normalize won't turn a song up past where its peaks would distort, so a few land a little quiet. On: those get the limiter instead (the file is rewritten; the original is backed up).

AudioLeveler_lossless.tip: Changes an MP3's volume in steps of about 1.5 dB without re-encoding, like MP3Gain. Other changes re-encode at top quality.

AudioLeveler_autoLevel.tip: Measures and levels songs and videos added or replaced after you turn this on, once no show is playing. Songs set to Skip are left alone.

AudioLeveler_backup.description: Keep originals so they can be restored
AudioLeveler_backup.tip: Keeps each original the first time it's changed, so Restore can put it back.

AudioLeveler_waitIdle.description: Wait until no show is playing
AudioLeveler_waitIdle.tip: Off: work runs at low priority during the show. A playing song is never replaced.
